subject: Priority support coverage & commercial proposal for Orchard Analytics
messages:
From: Caroline Park <caroline@orchardanalytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Walsh <ben.walsh@orchardanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Premium support needs + pricing questions

Hi Jasmine / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the runtime performance looks very promising. Before we move into procurement, the leadership team asked me to get firm numbers and a simple picture of what a "premium support" package would look like. High level asks: 

- 24/7 pager coverage for P1 incidents (on-call rotation).
- Defined credit scheme for downtime (we operate customer-facing features; credits need to be meaningful).
- A seat/commit discount if we sign a 12-month commercial commitment (we expect ~10 active engineers calling the API during peak).
- Clarify escalation coverage for third-party connectors (we have a few integrations with vendor SDKs).

Can you send a short matrix (options and pricing) and any sample contract language your team expects? Procurement will need the exact credit formula and any cap on credits.

Thanks — if easier, feel free to propose two or three package options and we can pick.

—Caroline
Caroline Park
Head of Integrations, Orchard Analytics
caroline@orchardanalytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

(P.S. Ben will be helping review the commercial terms.)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Park <caroline@orchardanalytics.com>, Ben Walsh <ben.walsh@orchardanalytics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Premium support needs + pricing questions

Caroline — thanks, great summary. Attaching a concise support matrix (support_matrix_v3.pdf) and a redlineable clause draft (clause_draft.docx). Quick summary in-line so procurement has something to react to: 

Option A — Premium (Recommended)
- 99.99% uptime SLA (monthly).
- 24/7 P1 on-call; 1-hour initial response for P1, 4 hours for P2, 48 hours for P3.
- Credits: 5% credit per 30 minutes of qualifying downtime up to a 30% cap per incident; aggregate annual cap 40% of monthly support fee.
- Escalation: direct escalation to engineering + weekly RCA while issue open. Covers Redwood-managed connectors; third-party vendor issues handled case-by-case (we provide triage but vendor fix responsibility remains).
- Price: support fee = $6,500/mo (covers up to 10 named seats); additional seat(s) $450/mo each.

Option B — Business Hours
- 99.9% uptime SLA. 8x5 on-call (business hours). P1 response 2 hours. Credits smaller (2% per 30 minutes, 20% cap). Price = $3,500/mo.

Option C — Dedicated Response Retainer
- 24/7 dedicated rotation (higher-level SLA guarantees) + onboarding retainer for playbook creation. Custom pricing (starts at $18k/mo).

Notes / negotiation levers:
- Seat discount for 12-month prepay: typically 10–15% depending on term.
- Credit caps are negotiable (finance/legal prefer an aggregate annual cap to limit exposure).
- We can expand escalation language for third-party connectors into a managed-services addendum (if you want Redwood to own vendor escalation).

Next steps: I can loop in procurement/legal with preferred option and I can circulate a DocuSign-ready term sheet. Which option should I draft into the term sheet?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 (646) 555-2241

Attachments: support_matrix_v3.pdf (4 pages), clause_draft.docx (redlineable)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Premium support needs + pricing questions

Quick internal note / negotiation guidance — copying here so we have a single record before sending a final commercial: 

- Credit structure: finance wants a lower aggregate exposure. Suggest we change Option A caps to 25% per incident and 30% aggregate annual cap (instead of 30%/40%). Keep 5% per 30 min to keep incentive alignment.
- Seat discount: OK to offer 15% for a 12-month prepay or 12% for 12-month monthly invoiced.
- On-call: agree to 24/7 P1 but add a requirement for Orchard to maintain an on-call liaison and agreed escalation playbook (reduces false positives).
- Third-party connectors: do not accept full ownership of vendor fixes. Offer managed escalation addendum at $2k/mo.
- DocuSign: prepare two variants (prepay vs monthly) so we can accelerate signature.

Monica: can you confirm operational readiness (liaison + playbook) and approximate start date? Rishi — please review the proposed cap changes and vendor escalation language; want to give Caroline a firm position today.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Caroline Park <caroline@orchardanalytics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Walsh <ben.walsh@orchardanalytics.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@orchardanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Premium support needs + pricing questions

Thanks — the matrix is helpful. A few counterpoints from procurement: 

- Credit cap: we need an aggregate cap that doesn't materially exceed the monthly support fee (our board will not approve open-ended exposure). Would Orchard accept an aggregate annual cap of 100% of the annual support spend (i.e., at most one month free per year)? That keeps it simple.
- Seat discount: 15% for prepay is reasonable; procurement is pushing for 18% if we commit to a 24-month term. Can you confirm flexibility?
- Managed vendor escalation: we prefer Redwood to take ownership up to the point of vendor remediation (we will accept a higher monthly fee if necessary). Please clarify what "managed escalation addendum" covers in practice. Will it include outbound pressure, escalation calls, and single-thread ownership through vendor resolution?

If you can update the term sheet with a prepay 15% and a variant with 18% for 24-month, that would speed approvals. Also include a short example calculation (monthly fee, credit example after a 90-minute outage).

—Caroline
Caroline Park
Head of Integrations, Orchard Analytics

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Park <caroline@orchardanalytics.com>, Ben Walsh <ben.walsh@orchardanalytics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Premium support needs + pricing questions — proposed final terms

Caroline / Ben — thanks for the quick feedback. Attached is final_terms_orchard_v2.pdf and a DocuSign link (DocuSign in related links). Below is the TL;DR of the variant we recommend and the alternate (prepay/24-month) you asked for.

Recommended (12-month prepay) — Final commercial
- Support tier: Premium (Option A).
- SLA: 99.99% monthly. P1 initial response = 1 hour, P2 = 4 hours, P3 = 48 hours.
- Credits: 5% per 30 minutes of qualifying downtime; per-incident cap 25%; aggregate annual cap = 100% of annual support spend (i.e., at most 1 month equivalent of support fees back per year). Example: $6,500/mo support fee; a 90-minute downtime results in 10% credit (5% per 30m x 3) applied to the next invoice (~$650 credit).
- Seats: Base covers up to 10 named seats. Additional seats $450/mo. 12-month prepay discount = 15% off support fee.
- 24-month prepay variant: 18% discount off support fee (same SLA/credits).
- Third-party connectors: managed escalation addendum available for $2,000/mo. Covers single-thread ownership, vendor pressure/escalation calls, and weekly status updates until resolution. Redwood remains dependent on vendor fixes for third-party root causes; addendum buys prioritized coordination and ownership of the process.
- Onboarding: we require a designated Orchard liaison + a joint escalation playbook as part of onboarding (we'll draft).

Ask: If this matches your expectations we'll route the 12-month prepay term via DocuSign and include the 24-month prepay variant as an optional amendment. Please confirm which variant you want signed by EOD Monday and we'll prepare the final packet for procurement.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through numbers.

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 (646) 555-2241

Attachments: final_terms_orchard_v2.pdf (6 pages)
